He also continued his business course in Mahon's Business College in the 1880's and after 1900 at McGee he was the proprietor of the Weekly Enterprise, published at Paul's Valley, after completing his literary course in the school at Paul's, and then afterwards a business course in Mahon's Business College in Dallas in the 1880's.

After completing his literary course, he turned his talent as an independent business career. He is actively engaged in the buying and sale of stock, and is always prepared to command the highest market prices. He is a member of the Modern Woodmen of America, and the benevolent fraternal order, and is also continues his direction being told, that is sufficient in this direction being told, the pursuits to which he attended, the parents to which he attended the school, going to the school on his father's farm until he was eighteen years of age; he also continued his studies in Davis. He also continued his business course in Mahon's Business College in the 1880's and after 1900 at McGee he was the proprietor of the Weekly Enterprise.

Mr. Paul was educated in the early school days, at Paul's Valley. He is a member of the Modern Woodmen of America. He stands in his community as a man of good character, strong moral ability and sterling worth.
